newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Nepal tenders to buy diesel, kerosene for March.
newsitem.headline: Nepal tenders to buy diesel, kerosene for March.

text.p: State-owned Nepal Oil Corp (NOC) has issued a tender to buy two 30,000-tonne cargoes of superior kerosene and one 30,000-tonne cargo high speed diesel for March deliveries, industry sources said on Monday.
The tender seeks 1.0-percent sulphur diesel for March 11-20 delivery and kerosene for March 1-10 and 21-31 deliveries on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis.
Offers are to be made on the basis of deliveries to Madras/Vizag, Madras/Haldia, Paradeep or Paradeep/Haldia on the Indian east coast.
The tender closes on February 5 and offers are valid to February 7.
NOC last bought diesel and kerosene for February arrival at $239.39 per tonne and $274 per tonne, respectively on a c-and-f east coast basis.
